trait.name: Multiple Heads
trait.text:
The dracohydra has five heads. While it has more than one head, the dracohydra has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.
Whenever the dracohydra takes 30 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, the dracohydra dies.
At the end of its turn, the dracohydra grows two heads for each of its heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken radiant damage since its last turn. The dracohydra regains 10 hit points for each head regrown this way.

trait.name: Reactive Heads
trait.text: For each head the dracohydra has beyond one, it gets an extra reaction that can be used only for opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Wakeful
trait.text: While the dracohydra sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The dracohydra makes as many Bite attacks as it has heads.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) damage of a type chosen by the dracohydra: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison.

action.name: Prismatic Breath (Recharge 4–6)
action.text: The dracohydra's heads exhale a single breath of multicolored energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 33 (6d10) damage of a type chosen by the dracohydra: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage.

monster.name: Draconian Dreadnought
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 177

trait.name: Death Throes
trait.text: When the draconian is reduced to 0 hit points, it bursts into flames and is reduced to ashes. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on the draconian must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The draconian makes two Serrated Sword attacks and one Tail attack.

action.name: Serrated Sword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

reaction.name: Shape Theft
reaction.text: After the draconian kills a Medium or smaller Humanoid, the draconian can magically transform itself to look and feel like that creature while retaining its game statistics (other than its size). This transformation lasts until the draconian dies or uses an action to end it.

monster.name: Draconian Foot Soldier
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 178

trait.name: Controlled Fall
trait.text: When the draconian falls and isn't incapacitated, it subtracts up to 100 feet from the fall when calculating the fall's damage.

trait.name: Death Throes
trait.text: When the draconian is reduced to 0 hit points, its body turns to stone and releases a petrifying gas. Each creature within 5 feet of the draconian must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be restrained as it begins to turn to stone. The restrained creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends; otherwise the creature is petrified for 1 minute. After 1 minute, the body of the draconian crumbles to dust.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The draconian makes two Shortsword attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

monster.name: Draconian Infiltrator
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 178

trait.name: Death Throes
trait.text: When the draconian is reduced to 0 hit points, it turns into a puddle of acid and splashes acid on those around it. Each creature within 5 feet of the draconian must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be covered in acid for 1 minute. A creature can use its action to scrape or wash the acid off itself or another creature. A creature covered in the acid takes 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns.

trait.name: Glide
trait.text: When the draconian falls and isn't incapacitated, it subtracts up to 100 feet from the fall when calculating the fall's damage, and it can move up to 2 feet horizontally for every 1 foot it descends.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The draconian makes two Dagger attacks. If both attacks hit the same creature, the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned until the end of the target's next turn. While poisoned in this way, the target is also paralyzed.

action.name: Dagger
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

monster.name: Draconian Mage
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 179

trait.name: Death Throes
trait.text: When the draconian is reduced to 0 hit points, its scales and flesh immediately shrivel away and its bones explode. Each creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or take 9 (2d8) force damage.

trait.name: Glide
trait.text: When the draconian falls and isn't incapacitated, it subtracts up to 100 feet from the fall when calculating the fall's damage, and it can move up to 2 feet horizontally for every 1 foot it descends.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The draconian makes two Trident or Necrotic Ray attacks.

action.name: Trident
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Necrotic Ray
action.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +4 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

action.name: Spellcasting
action.text:
The draconian casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12):
• 1/Day each: enlarge/reduce, invisibility, stinking cloud

monster.spells: enlarge/reduce, invisibility, stinking cloud

monster.name: Draconian Mastermind
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 180

trait.name: Death Throes
trait.text: When the draconian is reduced to 0 hit points, its magical essence lashes out as a ball of lightning at the closest creature within 30 feet of it before arcing out to up to two other creatures within 15 feet of the first. Each creature must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 9 (2d8) lightning damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't stunned.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The draconian makes three Rend or Energy Ray attacks.

action.name: Rend
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Energy Ray
action.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) force damage.

action.name: Noxious Breath (Recharge 5–6)
action.text: The draconian exhales a 15-foot cone of noxious gas. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 21 (6d6) poison damage and gains 1 level of exhaustion. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage, doesn't gain exhaustion, and is immune to all draconians' Noxious Breath for 24 hours.

action.name: Spellcasting
action.text:
The draconian casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):
• At will: invisibility, mage hand • 2/Day each: dimension door, disguise self, sending

reaction.name: Magic Shield (3/Day)
reaction.text: When the draconian is hit by an attack roll, it can create an invisible barrier of magical force around itself, granting it a +5 bonus to its AC against that attack and potentially causing the attack to miss.

monster.spells: invisibility, mage hand, dimension door, disguise self, sending

monster.name: Draconic Shard
monster.resist: acid, fire; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster.conditionImmune: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 181

trait.name: Deflection
trait.text: The shard's AC includes its Intelligence modifier.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
trait.text: The shard can move through creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. If it ends its turn inside an object, it takes 5 (1d10) force damage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If the shard fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
trait.text: When it drops to 0 hit points, the shard disappears and leaves a Tiny cracked gemstone in its space. The gemstone matches the kind of gem dragon it was in life and has AC 20, 15 hit points, and immunity to all damage except force. Unless the gemstone is destroyed, after 1d20 days, the gemstone dissipates and the shard re-forms, regaining all its hit points and appearing in the place the gemstone once occupied or in the nearest unoccupied space.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
trait.text: The shard doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The shard makes two Telekinetic Rend attacks.

action.name: Telekinetic Rend
action.text: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) force damage.

action.name: Inhabit Object
action.text:
The shard disappears as it pours its psychic essence into a Medium or smaller nonsentient object it can see within 30 feet of it, magically possessing it. The object uses the shard's AC, and any damage dealt to the object applies to the shard's hit points. The shard inhabits the object until it uses an action to leave; until it is turned; until it is reduced to 0 hit points; or until an effect that ends possession, such as a dispel evil and good spell, is used on it. When it leaves the object, it reappears in the nearest unoccupied space.
While inhabited, the object becomes a magic item if it wasn't already, and a Tiny cracked gemstone matching the kind of gem dragon the shard was in life appears somewhere on the object. The shard can cause the object to fly using the shard's own flying speed, use its senses, speak verbally or telepathically, cast spells, and use its legendary actions.
If a creature wears or carries the inhabited object, the shard can grant the creature the following benefits:
• Each of the creature's attacks deals an extra 1d8 force damage on a hit.
• The creature gains resistance to psychic damage.

action.name: Psychic Crush (Recharge 5–6)
action.text: The shard unleashes a pulse of psychic power. Each creature of the shard's choice in a 60-foot-radius sphere centered on it must make a DC 20 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 55 (10d10) psychic damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't stunned.

action.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
action.text:
The shard casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20):
• At will: detect thoughts, invisibility, telekinesis

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: The shard can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The shard regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Rend
legendary.text: The shard makes one Telekinetic Rend attack.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: The shard uses Spellcasting.

legendary.name: Commanding Thought (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: The shard targets a creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the end of its next turn. While charmed in this way, the target becomes the shard's puppet, acting and moving in accordance with its telepathic commands. While under the shard's control, the target can take only the Attack (shard chooses the target) or Dash action on its turn.

monster.spells: detect thoughts, invisibility, telekinesis

monster.name: Draconic Spirit
monster.speed: walk 30 ft., fly 60 ft., swim 30 ft.
monster.resist: acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison (Chromatic and Metallic Only), force, necrotic, psychic, radiant, thunder (Gem Only)
monster.languages: draconic, understands the languages you speak
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 21

trait.name: Stats
trait.text:
• Armor Class: 14 + the level of the spell (natural armor)
• Hit Points: 50 + 10 for each spell level above 5th (the dragon has a number of Hit Dice [d10s] equal to the level of the spell)
• Proficiency Bonus: equals your bonus

trait.name: Shared Resistances
trait.text: When you summon the dragon, choose one of its damage resistances. You have resistance to the chosen damage type until the spell ends.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The dragon makes a number of Rend attacks equal to half the spell's level (rounded down), and it uses Breath Weapon.

action.name: Rend
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: your spell attack modifier to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 1d6 + 4 + the spell's level piercing damage.

action.name: Breath Weapon
action.text: The dragon exhales destructive energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC. A creature takes 2d6 damage of a type this dragon has resistance to (your choice) on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster.name: Dragon Blessed
monster.languages: Common, Draconic, and any two languages
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 188

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The blessed makes two Mace or Radiant Bolt attacks.

action.name: Mace
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) radiant damage.

action.name: Radiant Bolt
action.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (5d8) radiant damage, and the blessed regains 5 (1d10) hit points.

action.name: Spellcasting
action.text:
The blessed casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):
• At will: light, thaumaturgy • 1/Day each: enhance ability, flame strike, mass cure wounds, revivify, tongues

monster.spells: light, thaumaturgy, enhance ability, flame strike, mass cure wounds, revivify, tongues

monster.name: Dragon Chosen
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 189

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The chosen makes one Handaxe attack and two Shortsword attacks.

action.name: Handaxe
action.text:
Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.
Hit or Miss: The handaxe magically returns to the chosen's hand immediately after a ranged attack.

action.name: Shortsword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Biting Rebuke
reaction.text: Immediately after the chosen takes damage from a creature within 5 feet of it, it can make a Shortsword attack with advantage against that creature.

monster.name: Dragon Speaker
monster.languages: Common, Draconic, and any two languages
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 189

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The speaker makes two Thunder Bolt attacks.

action.name: Thunder Bolt
action.text: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d8) thunder damage, and the target is pushed horizontally up to 10 feet away from the speaker.

action.name: Spellcasting
action.text:
The speaker casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):
• At will: dancing lights • 1/Day each: calm emotions, charm person, command, comprehend languages

reaction.name: Disarming Words (3/Day)
reaction.text: When a creature the speaker can see within 60 feet of it makes a damage roll, the speaker can roll a d6 and subtract the number rolled from that damage roll.

monster.name: Dragon Turtle Wyrmling
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 192

trait.name: Amphibious
trait.text: The dragon turtle can breathe air and water.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Steam Breath (Recharge 5–6)
action.text: The dragon turtle exhales steam in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 17 (5d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Being underwater doesn't grant resistance against this damage.

monster.name: Dragonblood Ooze
monster.conditionImmune: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, prone, restrained
monster.languages: understands Draconic and the languages of its creator but can't speak
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 182

trait.name: Amorphous
trait.text: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Spider Climb
trait.text: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The ooze makes two Pseudopod attacks. The ooze can replace one Pseudopod attack with its Slime Breath, if available.

action.name: Pseudopod
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) acid damage.
If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target takes 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns.

action.name: Slime Breath (Recharge 6)
action.text: The ooze expels a spray of its gelatinous mass in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 22 (4d10) acid damage and is pulled up to 30 feet straight toward the ooze. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't pulled.

monster.name: Dragonbone Golem
monster.conditionImmune: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
monster.languages: understands Draconic and the languages of its creator but can't speak
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 183

trait.name: Fear Aura
trait.text: Each creature of the golem's choice that starts its turn within 20 feet of the golem must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw unless the golem is incapacitated. On a failed save, the creature is frightened until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature is immune to this golem's Fear Aura for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
trait.text: The golem doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The golem makes one Pinion attack and two Rend attacks.

action.name: Pinion
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage.
If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is pinned beneath the bony pinion and restrained. The golem has two pinions, each of which can restrain one target. If a creature is restrained by one of the pinions, the golem can't attack with it. Any creature restrained by a pinion can free itself at the start of its turn with a successful DC 17 Strength (Athletics) check.

action.name: Rend
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.

action.name: Petrifying Breath (Recharge 5–6)
action.text: The golem emits a 60-foot cone of petrifying gas from its mouth. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 35 (10d6) poison damage and be restrained as it begins to turn to stone. The restrained target must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the effect ends on the target. On a failed save, the target is petrified.

monster.name: Dragonborn of Bahamut
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 184

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
trait.text: If the dragonborn fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The dragonborn makes three Longsword attacks.

action.name: Longsword
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 13 (3d8) radiant damage.
The dragonborn can cause the sword to flare with bright light, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the start of the dragonborn's next turn. The sword can flare in this way only once per turn.

action.name: Healing Touch (1/Day)
action.text: The dragonborn touches another creature within 5 feet of it. The target magically regains 40 hit points. In addition, all diseases and poisons affecting the target are removed.

action.name: Radiant Breath (Recharge 6)
action.text: The dragonborn exhales fiery radiance in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 44 (8d10) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. When the dragonborn uses this action, it can choose up to three creatures in the cone. These creatures take no damage from the radiance and instead regain 22 (4d10) hit points each.

monster.name: Dragonborn of Sardior
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 185

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
trait.text: If the dragonborn fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Mental Defense
trait.text: While the dragonborn is wearing no armor, its AC includes its Intelligence modifier.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The dragonborn makes three Mind Blade attacks.

action.name: Mind Blade
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4+4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage.

action.name: Heat Breath (Recharge 6)
action.text: The dragonborn exhales a wave of intense heat in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Metal objects in that area glow red-hot until the end of the dragonborn's next turn. Any creature in physical contact with a heated object at the start of its turn must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 9 (2d8) fire damage and has disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
action.text:
The dragonborn casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks):
• 1/Day each: Bigby's hand, hypnotic pattern, telekinesis

monster.spells: Bigby's hand, hypnotic pattern, telekinesis

monster.name: Dragonborn of Tiamat
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 185

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
trait.text: If the dragonborn fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The dragonborn makes two Greataxe attacks.

action.name: Greataxe
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d12+5) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.

action.name: Necrotic Breath (Recharge 6)
action.text: The dragonborn exhales shadowy fire in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 36 (8d8) necrotic damage and is frightened of the dragonborn for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't frightened. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

monster.name: Dragonflesh Abomination
monster.languages: understands Common and Draconic but can't speak
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 187

trait.name: Cloying Miasma
trait.text: The abomination is surrounded by a noxious stench. At the start of the abomination's turn, any creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of the abomination's next turn.

trait.name: Regeneration
trait.text: The abomination regains 10 hit points at the start of its turns if it has at least 1 hit point.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The abomination makes three attacks using Claw, Acidic Spit, or a combination of them. It can replace one of the attacks with a Tail attack.

action.name: Claw
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 5 (1d10) poison damage.

action.name: Tail
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Acidic Spit
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) acid damage.

action.name: Acid Belch (Recharge 5–6)
action.text: The abomination belches forth a cloud of acidic gas in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster.name: Dragonflesh Grafter
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 186

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The grafter makes one Claw attack and one Greatclub attack.

action.name: Claw
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage plus 5 (1d10) poison damage.

action.name: Greatclub
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Acid Retch (Recharge 5–6)
action.text: The grafter retches forth a spray of acidic bile in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster.name: Dragonnel
monster.languages: understands Draconic and Common but can't speak
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 190

trait.name: Flyby
trait.text: The dragonnel doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The dragonnel makes two Rend attacks.

action.name: Rend
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

monster.name: Drake Companion
monster.immune: determined by the drake's Draconic Essence trait
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 15

trait.name: Stats
trait.text: Armor Class: 14 + PB (natural armor) Hit Points: 5 + five times your ranger level (the drake has a number of hit dice [d10s] equal to your ranger level) Saving Throws: Dex +1 plus PB, Wis +2 plus PB Proficiency Bonus: equals your bonus

trait.name: Draconic Essence
trait.text: When you summon the drake, choose a damage type: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. The chosen type determines the drake's damage immunity and the damage of its Infused Strikes trait.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d6 plus PB piercing damage.

reaction.name: Infused Strikes
reaction.text: When another creature within 30 feet of the drake that it can see hits a target with a weapon attack, the drake infuses the strike with its essence, causing the target to take an extra 1d6 damage of the type determined by its Draconic Essence.

monster.name: Egg Hunter Adult
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 193

trait.name: Amphibious
trait.text: The egg hunter can breathe air and water.

trait.name: False Appearance
trait.text: If the egg hunter is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the egg hunter move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the egg hunter is animate. Dragons have disadvantage on this check.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The egg hunter makes two Barbed Proboscis attacks, and it can use Torpor Spores if it's available.

action.name: Barbed Proboscis
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage, and the egg hunter regains hit points equal to the necrotic damage dealt.

action.name: Torpor Spores (Recharge 5–6)
action.text: The egg hunter releases a billow of sparkling blue spores. Each creature in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on the egg hunter must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, the creature can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn but not both, and it can't take reactions. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to this egg hunter's Torpor Spores for the next 24 hours.

reaction.name: Rapid Adaptation
reaction.text: When the egg hunter takes damage, it gives itself resistance to that damage.

monster.name: Egg Hunter Hatchling
monster.speed: walk 30 ft., burrow 10 ft., climb 30 ft.
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 193

trait.name: Amphibious
trait.text: The egg hunter can breathe air and water.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The egg hunter makes two Egg Tooth attacks.

action.name: Egg Tooth
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage, or 17 (4d6 + 3) piercing damage if the target is an object.

reaction.name: Rapid Movement
reaction.text: The egg hunter takes the Dash or Disengage action.

monster.name: Elder Brain Dragon
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 194

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
trait.text: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Siege Monster
trait.text: The dragon deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
trait.text: The dragon doesn't require air or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The dragon makes one Bite attack, two Claw attacks, and one Tentacle attack.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) psychic damage.

action.name: Claw
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d6 + 8) slashing damage.

action.name: Tentacle
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. Hit: 12 (1d8 + 8) psychic damage.
If the target is Huge or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 18). The dragon can have up to four targets grappled at a time.

action.name: Tadpole Brine Breath (Recharge 5–6)
action.text:
The dragon exhales brine in a 120-foot line that is 15 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw, taking 55 (10d10) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a success or failure, if the creature isn't a Construct or an Undead, it becomes infested with illithid tadpoles.
While infested, the creature takes 16 (3d10) psychic damage at the start of each of its turns. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself after it succeeds on three of these saves. If the creature is targeted by magic that ends a curse or restores 40 hit points or more, the tadpoles infesting the creature are killed instantly, ending the effect on the creature.
If a Humanoid is reduced to 0 hit points while infested, the creature is stable but remains unconscious for 6d12 hours. When the period of unconsciousness ends, the creature transforms into a mind flayer (see the Monster Manual) with all its hit points. Casting a wish spell on the unconscious creature rids it of the infestation and prevents it from turning into a mind flayer.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: The dragon can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The dragon regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Tentacle
legendary.text: The dragon makes one Tentacle attack.

legendary.name: Shatter Concentration (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: The dragon targets a creature it is grappling. The target's concentration on a spell it has cast or an ability it is maintaining ends, and the target takes 19 (3d12) psychic damage.

monster.name: Emerald Dragon Wyrmling
monster.speed: walk 30 ft., burrow 20 ft., fly 60 ft.
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 197

trait.name: Tunneler
trait.text: The dragon can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and can leave a 15-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) psychic damage.

action.name: Disorienting Breath (Recharge 5–6)
action.text: The dragon exhales a wave of psychic dissonance in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 12 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 17 (5d6) psychic damage, and until the end of its next turn, when the creature makes an attack roll or an ability check, it must roll a d4 and reduce the total by the number rolled. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage with no additional effects.

action.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
action.text:
The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12):
• At will: mage hand (the hand is invisible), minor illusion

monster.spells: mage hand, minor illusion

monster.name: Emerald Greatwyrm
monster.speed: walk 60 ft., burrow 60 ft., fly 120 ft. (hover), swim 60 ft.
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 201

trait.name: Gem Awakening (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
trait.text: If the greatwyrm would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 400 hit points, it recharges its Breath Weapon, and it regains any expended uses of Legendary Resistance. Additionally, the greatwyrm can now use its Mass Telekinesis action during the next hour. Award a party an additional 90,000 XP (180,000 XP total) for defeating the greatwyrm after its Gem Awakening activates.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
trait.text: If the greatwyrm fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
trait.text: The greatwyrm doesn't require food or drink.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The greatwyrm makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (2d10 + 9) piercing damage plus 16 (3d10) force damage.

action.name: Claw
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d8 + 9) slashing damage.
If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 19) and is restrained until this grapple ends. The greatwyrm can have only one creature grappled in this way at a time.

action.name: Breath Weapon (Recharge 5–6)
action.text: The greatwyrm exhales crushing force in a 300-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 71 (11d12) force damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone. On a success or failure, the creature's speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Mass Telekinesis (Gem Awakening Only; Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
action.text:
The greatwyrm targets any number of creatures and objects it can see within 120 feet of it. No one target can weigh more than 4,000 pounds, and objects can't be targeted if they're being worn or carried. Each targeted creature must succeed on a DC 26 Strength saving throw or be restrained in the greatwyrm's telekinetic grip. At the end of a creature's turn, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.
At the end of the greatwyrm's turn, it can move each creature or object it has in its telekinetic grip up to 60 feet in any direction, but not beyond 120 feet of itself. In addition, it can choose any number of creatures restrained in this way and deal 45 (7d12) force damage to each of them.

action.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
action.text:
The greatwyrm casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 26, +18 to hit with spell attack):
• 1/Day each: dispel magic, forcecage, plane shift, reverse gravity, time stop

action.name: Change Shape (Bonus Action)
action.text: The greatwyrm magically transforms into any creature that is Medium or Small, while retaining its game statistics (other than its size). This transformation ends if the greatwyrm is reduced to 0 hit points or uses a bonus action to end it.

action.name: Psychic Step (Bonus Action)
action.text: The greatwyrm magically teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet of it.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: The greatwyrm can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The greatwyrm regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Claw
legendary.text: The greatwyrm makes one Claw attack.

legendary.name: Psionics (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: The greatwyrm uses Psychic Step or Spellcasting.

legendary.name: Psychic Beam (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary.text: The greatwyrm emits a beam of psychic energy in a 90-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a DC 26 Intelligence saving throw, taking 27 (5d10) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster.spells: dispel magic, forcecage, plane shift, reverse gravity, time stop

monster.name: Eyedrake
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 199

trait.name: Unusual Nature
trait.text: The eyedrake doesn't require food or drink.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Antimagic Breath (Recharge 6)
action.text: The eyedrake emits a magic wave in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 39 (6d12) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Every spell of 3rd level or lower ends on creatures and objects of the eyedrake's choice in that area.

action.name: Eye Rays
action.text:
The eyedrake shoots three of the following magical eye rays at random (reroll duplicates), each ray targeting one creature it can see within 60 feet of it:
1: Freezing Ray. The target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 17 (5d6) cold damage, and its speed is halved until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage with no additional effects.
2: Debilitating Ray. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (2d6) thunder damage and become incapacitated until the end of its next turn.
3: Repulsion Ray. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or take 14 (4d6) force damage and be pushed up to 60 feet away from the eyedrake.
4: Fire Ray. The target must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
5: Paralyzing Ray. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
6: Death Ray. The target must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The target dies if the ray reduces it to 0 hit points.

monster.name: Gem Stalker
monster.languages: Telepathy 60 ft. understands Draconic but can't speak
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 202

trait.name: Spider Climb
trait.text: The gem stalker can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
trait.text: The gem stalker doesn't require food or drink.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The gem stalker makes four Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Crystal Dart (Bonus Action)
action.text:
Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) force damage, and one of the following effects occurs, determined by the kind of dragon that created the gem stalker:
Amethyst: The gem stalker can teleport to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet of it.
Crystal: The gem stalker gains a number of temporary hit points equal to the damage dealt.
Emerald: The target must roll a d4 and subtract the number rolled from the next attack roll it makes before the start of the gem stalker's next turn.
Sapphire: The target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be pushed horizontally up to 10 feet away from the gem stalker and be knocked prone.
Topaz: The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of the gem stalker's next turn.

reaction.name: Protective Link
reaction.text: When another creature the gem stalker can see within 30 feet of it is about to take damage, the gem stalker reduces that damage by 10 (3d6). The gem stalker then takes damage equal to that amount.

monster.name: Ghost Dragon
monster.conditionImmune: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 203

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
trait.text: The ghost dragon can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If the ghost dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
trait.text: The ghost dragon doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The ghost dragon makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (6d8 + 5) cold damage, and the target's speed is halved until the start of the dragon's next turn.

action.name: Claw
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) necrotic damage.

action.name: Terrifying Breath (Recharge 6)
action.text:
The ghost dragon exhales shadowy mist in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 40 (9d8) cold damage and is frightened of the ghost dragon for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't frightened.
While frightened of the ghost dragon, a creature is paralyzed. The frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to this ghost dragon's Terrifying Breath for the next 24 hours.

monster.name: Gold Greatwyrm
monster.speed: walk 60 ft., burrow 60 ft., fly 120 ft., swim 60 ft.
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 208

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)

action.name: Breath Weapon (Recharge 5–6)

An unconscious creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendary.text: The greatwyrm makes one Claw or Tail attack.

legendary.name: Bite

legendary.name: Shattering Roar (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: The greatwyrm unleashes a magical roar. Each creature in a 120-foot-radius sphere centered on the greatwyrm must succeed on a DC 26 Constitution saving throw or take 19 (3d12) thunder damage and be incapacitated until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Arcane Spear (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary.text: The greatwyrm creates four spears of magical force. Each spear hits a creature of the greatwyrm's choice it can see within 120 feet of it, dealing 12 (1d8 + 8) force damage to its target, then disappears.

legendary.name: Mythic Actions
legendary.text: If the greatwyrm's Chromatic Awakening trait has activated in the last hour, it can use the options below as legendary actions.

legendary.name: Bite

legendary.name: Chromatic Flare (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: The greatwyrm flares with elemental energy. Each creature in a 60-foot-radius sphere centered on the greatwyrm must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or take 22 (5d8) poison damage.

monster.name: Hoard Mimic
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 204

trait.name: False Appearance (Hoard Form Only)
trait.text: If the mimic is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the mimic move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the mimic is animate.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The mimic makes one Bite attack and two Pseudopod attacks.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

action.name: Pseudopod
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the mimic adheres to the target.
A creature adhered to the mimic is also grappled by it (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. Ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage.

action.name: Caustic Mist (Recharge 5–6)
action.text: The mimic sprays a fine mist of acid in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 27 (6d8) acid damage and is blinded until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't blinded.

action.name: Shapechanger
action.text: The mimic transforms into a hoard or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

monster.name: Hoard Scarab
monster.speed: walk 20 ft., burrow 20 ft., fly 20 ft.
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 205

trait.name: False Appearance
trait.text: If the scarab is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the scarab move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the scarab is animate.

action.name: Bite
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
If the target is a creature, it has disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Scale Dust (1/Day) (Bonus Action)
action.text: The scarab releases magical glittering dust from its wings. Each creature within 5 feet of the scarab must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be outlined in blue light for 10 minutes. While outlined in this way, a creature sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius and can't benefit from being invisible. In addition, every Dragon within 1 mile of the creature becomes aware of it and can unerringly track the creature. Casting dispel magic on the creature ends the effect on it.

monster.name: Hollow Dragon
monster.conditionImmune: charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 206

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If the hollow dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Reconstruction
trait.text:
When the hollow dragon is reduced to 0 hit points, its body breaks into nine pieces: two arms, two legs, two wings, a tail, a torso, and a head. Each piece is a Large object with AC 19, 27 hit points, and immunity to psychic and poison damage.
After 1d6 days, if all pieces are still within 6 miles of each other, they all teleport to the location of the head piece and merge with it, whereupon the hollow dragon regains all its hit points and becomes active again.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The hollow dragon makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks, and it can use Sapping Presence.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage.

On a failed save, the creature's speed is halved and it has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature is immune to this hollow dragon's Sapping Presence for 24 hours.

action.text: The hollow dragon exhales radiant flames in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 54 (12d8) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.text: The hollow dragon makes one Claw attack.

legendary.name: Ghostly Binding (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: The hollow dragon creates ethereal bindings around a creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be restrained until the end of the dragon's next turn.

legendary.name: Booming Scales (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary.text: A sudden loud ringing noise, painfully intense, erupts from the hollow dragon's frame. Each creature within 10 feet of the hollow dragon must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster.name: Liondrake
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 207

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The liondrake makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.
If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Claw
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Blood-Chilling Roar (Recharge 4–6)
action.text: The liondrake lets out a terrifying roar audible out to 300 feet. Any creature within 30 feet of the liondrake that can hear its roar must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the liondrake for 1 minute. A creature that fails the save by 5 or more is also paralyzed for the same duration. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this liondrake's Blood-Chilling Roar for the next 24 hours.

monster.name: Metallic Peacekeeper
monster.conditionImmune: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 210

trait.name: Immutable Form
trait.text: The peacekeeper is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Telepathic Bond
trait.text: While the peacekeeper is on the same plane of existence as its master, it can magically convey what it senses to its master, and the two can communicate telepathically with each other.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The peacekeeper makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Calming Mist (Recharge 5–6)
action.text: The peacekeeper releases a calming gas in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or become charmed by the peacekeeper for 1 minute. While charmed in this way, the creature is incapacitated and has a speed of 0.

monster.name: Metallic Warbler
monster.conditionImmune: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
monster.languages: understands Common and Draconic but can't speak
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 210

trait.name: Immutable Form
trait.text: The warbler is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Telepathic Bond
trait.text: While the warbler is on the same plane of existence as its master, it can magically convey what it senses to its master, and the two can communicate telepathically with each other.

action.name: Claw
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Calming Mist (Recharge 5–6)
action.text: The warbler releases a calming gas in a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 11 Charisma saving throw or become charmed by the warbler for 1 minute. While charmed in this way, the creature is incapacitated and has a speed of 0.

monster.name: Moonstone Dragon Wyrmling
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 213

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) radiant damage.

action.name: Breath Weapon (Recharge 5–6)
action.text:
The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons:
Dream Breath. The dragon exhales mist in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or fall unconscious for 10 minutes. This effect ends for a creature if the creature takes damage or someone uses an action to wake it.
Moonlight Breath. The dragon exhales a beam of moonlight in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster.name: Red Greatwyrm
monster.speed: walk 60 ft., burrow 60 ft., fly 120 ft., swim 60 ft.
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 168

trait.name: Chromatic Awakening (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
trait.text: If the greatwyrm would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 425 hit points, it recharges its Breath Weapon, and it regains any expended uses of Legendary Resistance. Additionally, the greatwyrm can now use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour. Award a party an additional 105,000 XP (210,000 XP total) for defeating the greatwyrm after its Chromatic Awakening activates.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
trait.text: If the greatwyrm fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The greatwyrm makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +18 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (2d10 + 10) piercing damage plus 13 (2d12) force damage.

action.name: Claw
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +18 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d8 + 10) slashing damage.
If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 20) and is restrained until this grapple ends. The greatwyrm can have only one creature grappled this way at a time.

action.name: Tail
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d8 + 10) bludgeoning damage.
If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 26 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Breath Weapon (Recharge 5–6)
action.text: The greatwyrm exhales a blast of energy in a 300-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 78 (12d12) fire damage. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: The greatwyrm can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The greatwyrm regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Attack
legendary.text: The greatwyrm makes one Claw or Tail attack.

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: The greatwyrm beats its wings. Each creature within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or take 17 (2d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The greatwyrm can then fly up to half its flying speed.

legendary.name: Arcane Spear (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary.text: The greatwyrm creates four spears of magical force. Each spear hits a creature of the greatwyrm's choice it can see within 120 feet of it, dealing 12 (1d8 + 8) force damage to its target, then disappears.

legendary.name: Mythic Actions
legendary.text: If the greatwyrm's Chromatic Awakening trait has activated in the last hour, it can use the options below as legendary actions.

legendary.name: Bite
legendary.text: The greatwyrm makes one Bite attack.

legendary.name: Chromatic Flare (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: The greatwyrm flares with elemental energy. Each creature in a 60-foot-radius sphere centered on the greatwyrm must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or take 22 (5d8) fire damage.

monster.name: Sapphire Dragon Wyrmling
monster.speed: walk 30 ft., burrow 15 ft., climb 30 ft., fly 60 ft.
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 216

trait.name: Spider Climb
trait.text: The dragon can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Tunneler
trait.text: The dragon can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and can leave a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) thunder damage.

action.name: Debilitating Breath (Recharge 5–6)
action.text: The dragon exhales a pulse of high-pitched, nearly inaudible sound in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 22 (4d10) thunder damage and is incapacitated until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't incapacitated.

action.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
action.text:
The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability:
• 1/Day each: alarm, Tenser's floating disk

action.name: Mass Telekinesis (Gem Awakening Only; Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)

Each targeted creature must succeed on a DC 26 Strength saving throw or be restrained in the greatwyrm's telekinetic grip. At the end of a creature's turn, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.
At the end of the greatwyrm's turn, it can move each creature or object it has in its telekinetic grip up to 60 feet in any direction, but not beyond 120 feet of itself. In addition, it can choose any number of creatures restrained in this way and deal 45 (7d12) force damage to each of them.

monster.name: Swarm of Hoard Scarabs
monster.speed: walk 20 ft., burrow 20 ft., fly 20 ft.
monster.conditionImmune: charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned
monster.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons p. 205

trait.name: False Appearance
trait.text: If the swarm is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the swarm move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the swarm is animate.

trait.name: Swarm
trait.text: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny scarab. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Swarm of Bites
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) piercing damage, or 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage if the swarm is at half of its hit points or fewer, and the target has disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Scale Dust (1/Day) (Bonus Action)
action.text: The swarm releases magical glittering dust from its wings. Each creature within 10 feet of the swarm must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be outlined in blue light for 10 minutes. While outlined in this way, a creature sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius and can't benefit from being invisible. In addition, every Dragon within 1 mile of the creature becomes aware of it and can unerringly track the creature. Casting dispel magic on the creature ends the effect on it.

trait.name: Amorphous
trait.text: The oblex can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Aversion to Fire
trait.text: If the oblex takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
trait.text: The oblex doesn't require sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The oblex makes two pseudopod attacks, and it uses Eat Memories.

action.name: Pseudopod
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

action.name: Eat Memories
action.text:
The oblex targets one creature it can see within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 18 (4d8) psychic damage and become memory drained until it finishes a short or long rest or until it benefits from the greater restoration or heal spell. Constructs, Oozes, Plants, and Undead succeed on the save automatically.
While memory drained, the target must roll a d4 and subtract the number rolled from its ability checks and attack rolls. Each time the target is memory drained beyond the first, the die size increases by one: the d4 becomes a d6, the d6 becomes a d8, and so on until the die becomes a d20, at which point the target becomes unconscious for 1 hour. The effect then ends.
The oblex learns all the languages a memory-drained target knows and gains all its skill proficiencies.

action.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
action.text:
The oblex casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC DC 15):
• 3/Day each: charm person (as 5th-level spell), detect thoughts, hypnotic pattern

action.name: Sulfurous Impersonation (bonus action)
action.text: The oblex extrudes a piece of itself that assumes the appearance of one Medium or smaller creature whose memories it has stolen. This simulacrum appears, feels, and sounds exactly like the creature it impersonates, though it smells faintly of sulfur. The oblex can impersonate 1d4 + 1 different creatures, each one tethered to its body by a strand of slime that can extend up to 120 feet away. The simulacrum is an extension of the oblex, meaning that the oblex occupies its space and the simulacrum's space simultaneously. The tether is immune to damage, but it is severed if there is no opening at least 1 inch wide between the oblex and the simulacrum. The simulacrum disappears if the tether is severed.

monster.spells: charm person, detect thoughts, hypnotic pattern

monster.description: Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p. 259, Volo's Guide to Monsters p. 209

action.name: Arcane Burst
action.text: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) force damage.

action.name: Spellcasting
action.text:
The apprentice casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12):
• At will: mage hand, prestidigitation • 1/Day each: burning hands, disguise self, mage armor

monster.spells: mage hand, prestidigitation, burning hands, disguise self, mage armor

monster.name: Archdruid
monster.description: Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p. 48, Volo's Guide to Monsters p. 210

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The archdruid makes three Staff or Wildfire attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Staff
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) poison damage.

action.name: Wildfire
action.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +9 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (6d6 + 5) fire damage, and the target is blinded until the start of the druid's next turn.

action.name: Spellcasting
action.text:
The archdruid casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):
• At will: beast sense, entangle, speak with animals • 3/Day each: animal messenger, dominate beast, faerie fire, tree stride • 1/Day each: commune with nature (as an action), mass cure wounds

action.name: Change Shape (2/Day) (bonus action)
action.text: The archdruid magically transforms into a Beast or an Elemental with a challenge rating of 6 or less and can remain in that form for up to 9 hours. The archdruid can choose whether its equipment falls to the ground, melds with its new form, or is worn by the new form. The archdruid reverts to its true form if it dies or falls unconscious. The archdruid can revert to its true form using a bonus action. While in a new form, the archdruid's stat block is replaced by the stat block of that form, except the archdruid keeps its current hit points, its hit point maximum, this bonus action, its languages and ability to speak, and its Spellcasting action. The new form's attacks count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistances and immunity to nonmagical attacks.

monster.spells: beast sense, entangle, speak with animals, animal messenger, dominate beast, faerie fire, tree stride, commune with nature, mass cure wounds

monster.name: Archer
monster.description: Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p. 49, Volo's Guide to Monsters p. 210

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The archer makes two Shortsword or Longbow attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Archer's Eye (3/Day) (bonus action)
action.text: Immediately after making an attack roll or a damage roll with a ranged weapon, the archer can roll a d10 and add the number rolled to the total.

monster.name: Armanite
monster.description: Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p. 50, Mordenkainen's Tome of Foes p. 131

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: The armanite has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The armanite makes one Claw attack, one Hooves attack, and one Serrated Tail attack.

action.name: Claw
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) lightning damage.

action.name: Hooves
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Serrated Tail
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Lightning Lance (Recharge 5–6)
action.text: The armanite looses a bolt of lightning in a line that is 60 feet long and 10 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster.name: Astral Dreadnought
monster.resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster.conditionImmune: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, stunned
monster.description: Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p. 51, Mordenkainen's Tome of Foes p. 117

trait.name: Antimagic Cone
trait.text: The dreadnought's eye creates an area of antimagic, as in the antimagic field spell, in a 150-foot cone. At the start of each of its turns, it decides which way the cone faces. The cone doesn't function while the eye is closed or while the dreadnought is blinded.

trait.name: Astral Entity
trait.text: The dreadnought can't leave the Astral Plane, nor can it be banished or otherwise transported out of that plane.

trait.name: Demiplanar Donjon
trait.text: Anything the dreadnought swallows is transported to a demiplane that can be entered by no other means except a wish spell or the dreadnought's Bite and Donjon Visit. A creature can leave the demiplane only by using magic that enables planar travel, such as the plane shift spell. The demiplane resembles a stone cave roughly 1,000 feet in diameter with a ceiling 100 feet high. Like a stomach, it contains the remains of past meals. The dreadnought can't be harmed from within the demiplane. If the dreadnought dies, the demiplane disappears, and everything inside it appears around the dreadnought's corpse. The demiplane is otherwise indestructible.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If the dreadnought fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Sever Silver Cord
trait.text: If the dreadnought scores a critical hit against a creature traveling by means of the astral projection spell, the dreadnought can cut the target's silver cord instead of dealing damage.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
trait.text: The dreadnought doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The dreadnought makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (5d10 + 9) force damage.
If the target is a Huge or smaller creature and this damage reduces it to 0 hit points or it is incapacitated, the dreadnought swallows it. The swallowed target, along with everything it is wearing and carrying, appears in an unoccupied space on the floor of the Demiplanar Donjon.

action.name: Claw
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d6 + 9) force damage.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: The astral dreadnought can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The astral dreadnought regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Claw
legendary.text: The dreadnought makes one Claw attack.

legendary.name: Donjon Visit (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: One Huge or smaller creature that the dreadnought can see within 60 feet of it must succeed on a DC 19 Charisma saving throw or be teleported to an unoccupied space on the floor of the Demiplanar Donjon. At the end of the target's next turn, it reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.

legendary.name: Psychic Projection (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary.text: Each creature within 60 feet of the dreadnought must make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw, taking 26 (4d10 + 4) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster.name: Aurochs
monster.description: Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p. 71, Volo's Guide to Monsters p. 207

action.name: Gore
action.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.
If the aurochs moved at least 20 feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone if it is a creature.

monster.name: Autumn Eladrin
monster.description: Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p. 115, Mordenkainen's Tome of Foes p. 195

trait.name: Enchanting Presence
trait.text: Any non-eladrin creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the eladrin must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature becomes charmed by the eladrin for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature becomes immune to any eladrin's Enchanting Presence for 24 hours. Whenever the eladrin deals damage to the charmed creature, the charmed creature can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: The eladrin has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The eladrin makes two Longsword or Longbow attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Longsword
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage, or 6 (1d10 + 1) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 22 (5d8) psychic damage.

action.name: Longbow
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 22 (5d8) psychic damage.

action.name: Spellcasting
action.text:
The eladrin casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):
• At will: hold person • 2/Day each: cure wounds (as a 5th-level spell), lesser restoration • 1/Day each: greater restoration, revivify

action.name: Fey Step (Recharge 4–6) (bonus action)
action.text: The eladrin teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

reaction.name: Foster Peace
reaction.text: If a creature charmed by the eladrin hits with an attack roll while within 60 feet of the eladrin, the eladrin magically causes the attack to miss, provided the eladrin can see the attacker.

monster.spells: hold person, cure wounds, lesser restoration, greater restoration, revivify

monster.name: Babau
monster.resist: cold, fire, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster.description: Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p. 52, Volo's Guide to Monsters p. 136

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The babau makes two Claw attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting or Weakening Gaze.

action.name: Claw
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) acid damage.

action.name: Spellcasting
action.text:
The babau casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 11):
• At will: darkness, dispel magic, fear, heat metal, levitate

action.name: Weakening Gaze
action.text: The babau targets one creature that it can see within 20 feet of it. The target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target deals only half damage with weapon attacks that use Strength for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

monster.spells: darkness, dispel magic, fear, heat metal, levitate

monster.name: Bael
monster.resist: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
monster.description: Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p. 54, Mordenkainen's Tome of Foes p. 170

trait.name: Dread
trait.text: Any creature, other than a devil, that starts its turn within 10 feet of Bael must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of him until the start of its next turn. A creature succeeds on this saving throw automatically if Bael wishes it or if he is incapacitated.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If Bael fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Bael have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Regeneration
trait.text: Bael regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes cold or radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Bael dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Bael makes two Hellish Morningstar attacks.

action.name: Hellish Morningstar
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) force damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

action.name: Infernal Command
action.text: Each of Bael's allies within 60 feet of him can't be charmed or frightened until the end of his next turn.

action.name: Spellcasting
action.text:
Bael casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 21):
• At will: alter self (can become Medium), charm person, detect magic, invisibility, major image • 3/Day each: dispel magic, fly, suggestion, wall of fire • 1/Day: dominate monster

action.name: Teleport
action.text: Bael teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: Bael can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Bael regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Fiendish Magic
